description: Exact and context-bounded visual semantics for twenty punk-derived speculative genres and design shorthands. Every route carries an operating mechanism and a material proof object; palette, costume, or a lone motif never completes the meaning.

semantic_policy.established_routes: Exact names and unambiguous contextual meanings may enter post-core semantic discovery.
semantic_policy.shorthand_routes: Community and design shorthands require an exact term; their literal construction is request-bounded and does not claim a universal genre canon.
semantic_policy.actuation: Each routed preset requires one world-system carrier and one connected mechanism prop while subject identity and open authorial dimensions remain variable.
semantic_policy.collision_control: Punk music and fashion subcultures, cybergoth, generic retrofuturism, ordinary eco-architecture, generic fantasy, and named franchise imagery remain separate.
